description: Lightcurve Inversion Tool - Estimate initial attitude and angular velocity from observed lightcurves using optimization

userStories.title: Add emcee and corner to project dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the new dependencies added to the project.
acceptanceCriteria: Add emcee to requirements.txt or pyproject.toml
Add corner to requirements.txt or pyproject.toml

userStories.title: Create dynamics module structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the src/dynamics/ module scaffolding to organize attitude propagation code.

userStories.title: Implement principal axis rotation propagation
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to propagate attitude assuming constant angular velocity in body frame.
acceptanceCriteria: propagate_principal_axis(q0, omega, times) returns quaternion array shape (N, 4)
Uses closed-form solution: q(t) = q0 * quaternion_exp(0.5 * omega * dt)
Quaternions use scalar-first convention (w, x, y, z)

userStories.title: Implement tumbling Euler dynamics propagation
userStories.description: As a debris analyst, I want to propagate attitude with evolving angular velocity using Euler equations.
acceptanceCriteria: propagate_euler(q0, omega0, inertia_tensor, times) returns (quaternions, omega_history)
Integrates coupled ODE: Euler equations + quaternion kinematics
Uses scipy.integrate.solve_ivp with RK45 or DOP853

userStories.title: Create unified propagate_attitude interface
userStories.description: As a user, I want a single function to choose between propagation modes.
acceptanceCriteria: propagate_attitude(q0, omega0, times, mode, inertia_tensor=None) dispatches to correct propagator
mode='tumbling' calls propagate_euler and requires inertia_tensor
Raises ValueError if tumbling mode without inertia_tensor

userStories.title: Add STL volume calculation utility
userStories.description: As an engineer, I need to compute mesh volume using the signed tetrahedra method.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_mesh_volume(mesh) returns float volume using divergence theorem
Uses signed tetrahedra method summing contributions from each face

userStories.title: Add mesh watertight validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want warnings if my STL mesh is not closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Checks that mesh is closed (each edge shared by exactly 2 faces)
compute_mesh_volume logs warning if mesh is not watertight

userStories.title: Implement component inertia tensor calculation
userStories.description: As an engineer, I want to compute inertia tensor for a single STL component with given mass.
acceptanceCriteria: compute_component_inertia(mesh, mass) returns 3x3 inertia tensor about component center of mass

userStories.title: Implement parallel axis theorem for inertia translation
userStories.description: As an engineer, I need to translate component inertia tensors to body frame origin.
acceptanceCriteria: translate_inertia(I_cm, mass, displacement) applies parallel axis theorem
Formula: I_body = I_cm + m * (d^2 * I - outer(d, d))
displacement is vector from body origin to component center of mass
Returns 3x3 inertia tensor about body origin

userStories.title: Implement full satellite inertia computation from STL components
userStories.description: As an engineer, I want to compute total satellite inertia from multiple STL components with masses.
acceptanceCriteria: InertiaResult contains: total_mass, center_of_mass, inertia_tensor, principal_moments, principal_axes
Handles same STL file used multiple times at different positions
Sums all component contributions using parallel axis theorem

userStories.title: Create inversion module structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the src/inversion/ module scaffolding for the inversion engine.

userStories.title: Implement quaternion utilities for optimization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need quaternion helper functions for the optimization loop.

userStories.title: Implement objective function wrapper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an objective function that wraps the forward model for optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: ObjectiveFunction class wraps LCAS generate_lightcurves forward model
evaluate(params) returns chi-squared residual between predicted and observed lightcurve
Internally propagates attitude and calls forward model
userStories.notes: Interface uses Satellite model and J2000 positions instead of abstract config objects for practical forward model integration

userStories.title: Implement weighted residual calculation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to weight observations by their uncertainties.
acceptanceCriteria: If uncertainties provided: chi_sq = sum((obs - pred)^2 / sigma^2)
If no uncertainties: use uniform weights (MSE)
Observations with infinite magnitude (not visible) are excluded

userStories.title: Implement Differential Evolution global optimizer
userStories.description: As a user, I want global optimization to avoid local minima.
acceptanceCriteria: bounds specify ranges for axis_angle and omega parameters
Default omega bounds: 0 to 30 deg/s magnitude
Returns OptimizationResult with best params and cost

userStories.title: Implement local refinement optimizer
userStories.description: As a user, I want local refinement to converge to precise optimum.
acceptanceCriteria: local_refine(objective, x0, bounds) uses scipy.optimize.minimize with L-BFGS-B
x0 is initial guess from global optimization
Quaternion constraint enforced via normalization after each iteration

userStories.title: Implement multi-start optimization wrapper
userStories.description: As a user, I want multiple random starts to improve robustness.
acceptanceCriteria: multi_start_optimize(objective, bounds, n_starts) runs optimization n_starts times
Each start uses different random initialization
Returns list of results sorted by cost
Best result returned as primary output

userStories.title: Implement constraint modes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose between free exploration and physics-informed constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: get_bounds(mode, omega_max) returns appropriate parameter bounds
FREE mode: minimal constraints (only omega magnitude bound)
PHYSICS_INFORMED mode: adds principal axis rotation constraint

userStories.title: Implement Fisher Information Matrix uncertainty estimation
userStories.description: As a user, I want quick uncertainty estimates using Fisher Information.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses numerical approximation of Hessian at optimum
Covariance = inverse of Fisher Information Matrix
Returns standard deviations for each parameter

userStories.title: Implement MCMC uncertainty estimation with emcee
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want full posterior characterization using MCMC sampling.

userStories.title: Implement InversionResult container class
userStories.description: As a user, I want a structured container for all inversion outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: InversionResult dataclass with fields: q0, omega0, chi_squared, rms_residual, uncertainties, predicted_lightcurve
For tumbling mode: includes omega_history over observation window
Includes observed vs predicted data for plotting

userStories.title: Implement result visualization methods
userStories.description: As a user, I want to visualize inversion results.
acceptanceCriteria: InversionResult.plot_corner() shows parameter posterior (requires MCMC samples)

userStories.title: Create main inversion API function
userStories.description: As a user, I want a single function to run the full inversion pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: invert_lightcurve(observed_lc, satellite_config, observer_config, ...) runs full pipeline
Runs global optimization, local refinement, uncertainty estimation

userStories.title: Create inertia calculation notebook
userStories.description: As an engineer, I want a notebook demonstrating inertia calculation from STL files.
acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrates loading STL components and assigning masses
Displays computed inertia tensor, principal moments, and principal axes
Includes comparison with analytical result for simple shape

userStories.title: Create attitude propagation demo notebook
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a notebook demonstrating the attitude propagator.
acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrates tumbling mode with Euler dynamics
Shows how to use propagator output with existing LCAS forward model
Visualizes quaternion and angular velocity evolution

userStories.title: Create lightcurve inversion workflow notebook
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want a notebook demonstrating the full inversion workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows round-trip validation: forward model -> inversion -> compare
Demonstrates both quick (Fisher) and full (MCMC) uncertainty modes
